t: A very fast dual-core RISC-V microcontroller for screens and industrial control.
steps: Buy the HPM6750EVK2 board from LCSC or HQChip. Check stock first, as LCSC showed none.
Install the HPM SDK from HPMicro's GitHub page with a RISC-V GCC toolchain.
Install the HPMicro OpenOCD fork, as the standard OpenOCD cannot flash this chip.
Plug the board into a computer with a USB-C cable to reach its onboard debugger.
Build the hello world sample for the HPM6750EVK2 and flash it.
Open a serial terminal to see the board print its greeting.
Try a graphics or Ethernet sample next.
